_instructions: TEMPLATE for AI agents: fill in this JSON to build a quiz for quiz-maker.html.
1. meta.language: which language(s) to use — "en", "ku", "both", or "auto" (default). "auto" keeps both languages when the input carries them, otherwise the single language present.
2. meta.title / meta.title_en: quiz name shown at the top. meta.subtitle / meta.subtitle_en: optional one line under it.
3. meta.intro / meta.intro_en: optional list of extra bullet lines for the start screen (category counts are added automatically). If omitted, two default bullets are used.
4. questions: array. Each item has category/category_en, question/question_en, options/options_en, correct (0-based index), explanation/explanation_en.
5. options and options_en must be the same length and same order; 'correct' points into that order.

6. Base keys are Kurdish; the '_en' keys are English. You may fill only one language; the other falls back automatically. With meta.language "both" (or "auto" when both languages are present) the quiz shows a Kurdish/English switch.
7. Remove this '_instructions' key when you are done (optional but cleaner).
